definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese unit of volume equal to approximately 1.8 liters. Still commonly used for measuring sake and rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一升|いっしょう}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought one shou of sake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一升瓶|いっしょうびん}→一升瓶：08958_isshoubin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: We opened a 1.8-liter bottle of wine.

examples.japanese: {一歳|いっさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一升|いっしょう}⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{背負|せお}わせる→背負う：16159_seou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧だ。
examples.english: Having a child carry a one-shou rice cake on their first birthday is a Japanese tradition.

notes:
A traditional unit of volume in the Japanese measurement system. One ⟦{升|しょう}→升：26042_shou⟧ equals approximately 1.8 liters (about 0.48 US gallons). Though the metric system is standard in Japan, ⟦{升|しょう}→升：26042_shou⟧ is still used in everyday life for sake and rice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一升瓶|いっしょうびん}→一升瓶：08958_isshoubin⟧: 1.8-liter bottle (standard large sake bottle)
- {一升|いっしょう}⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧: one-shou rice cake (used in first birthday celebrations)
- {一升|いっしょう}{炊|だ}き: cooking one shou of rice
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧{一升|いっしょう}: one shou of rice

MEASUREMENT CONTEXT:
- 1⟦{升|しょう}→升：26042_shou⟧ = 10⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ = approximately 1.8 liters
- 10⟦{升|しょう}→升：26042_shou⟧ = 1{斗|と}
- A standard sake cup measure ({一合|いちごう}) is one-tenth of a ⟦{升|しょう}→升：26042_shou⟧

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {一升|いっしょう}⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ tradition involves making a child carry a heavy rice cake (about 1.8 kg) on their first birthday. The custom symbolizes hopes that the child will never go hungry. The word {一升|いっしょう} is a pun on ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧ (a lifetime).
